in_marathi.name: Udarsh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Rising Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udarsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Udarsh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'udaya' meaning 'rising' and 'arsha' meaning 'sun'. It signifies the rising sun and symbolizes a new beginning.

in_bengali.name: Udarsh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The Rising Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Udarsh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Udarsh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'udaya' meaning 'rising' and 'arsha' meaning 'sun'. It signifies the rising sun and symbolizes a new beginning.
